subject.title: [Feature Request] Infrastructure Expansion: Time to implement Global Mirrors and Load Balancing for OpenClaw

question: Should ClawHub add repo-owned global mirrors and load balancing now, and if so what topology, providers, failover semantics, and security boundaries should source control own?
rationale: The request changes production availability and trust boundaries, and current source only has adjacent routing and mirror APIs without a maintainer-approved global architecture.

options.title: Design first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define the architecture, threat model, provider ownership, rollout, rollback, and validation plan before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to supported reuse
options.body: Treat this as documentation and API guidance for third-party caching/mirrors without building official global routing.

options.title: Defer official mirrors
options.body: Decline official mirrors and load balancing until there is a named operational owner and security review path.

recommendation.title: Design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define the architecture, threat model, provider ownership, rollout, rollback, and validation plan before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current routing candidate from CODEOWNERS and blame for the deploy, API, and security-sensitive documentation surface.
